guard: a persona file's agent: pin picks the spawn harness on every launch path: flag > file > COTAL_DEFAULT_AGENT > default, and a pin naming an unregistered connector fails loud
why: THE ORDERING IS THE DEFECT, SO THE PROOF TARGETS THE PRECEDENCE LINE, NOT THE LOADER. A unit
cell asserting def.agent === 'jcode' after loadAgentFile would kill a loader mutation while
proving nothing: #869's whole failure mode was that the real entry point resolved the connector
before the code that would read agent: ever ran. Every mutation here is aimed at a line the
REAL spawn path consults, graded by the reachability suite, which drives the kernel-parsed CLI
spawn command over a real control plane into a real Manager (throwaway broker on an
OS-assigned port) and records WHICH connector's buildLaunch ran.
EVERY COMMAND BUILDS FIRST, AND EVERY afterRestore REBUILDS. The suite imports
@cotal-ai/core, @cotal-ai/manager and @cotal-ai/cli as workspace deps, which resolve to
dist/. A mutation applied to src that is not built is a mutation the run never sees (it would
come back SURVIVED and read as 'this line does not matter' when what was measured is 'this
line was not in the artifact'). dist/ is gitignored, so git cannot be the recovery; the
rebuild in afterRestore keeps the tree from carrying a mutant-compiled dist after the source
is restored.
CELL A IS THE ISSUE'S EXACT REPRO and the mutation-proof target the lane named: file pins
'pin', COTAL_DEFAULT_AGENT=other, spawn --detach with no --agent. The manager-precedence
mutation restores exactly the shipped defect on that cell (env beats file), the
cli-collapse mutation restores the pre-wire collapse (flag and env indistinguishable to the
manager), and the foreground mutation restores the foreground variant of the same ignore.
The loader mutation proves the modelling (agent: must parse as a field, not meta), and the
requiredExtensions mutation guards the preflight cell that would otherwise be dead on
arrival on the published binary with no unit test able to see it.
CELL C PROVES DETACHED CALLER-DEFAULT CONTINUITY across a real process and control-plane
boundary. The already-running manager has no COTAL_DEFAULT_AGENT while the child CLI alone
sets it to 'other'. Removing the dedicated control field or placing it below the manager's
own environment both redden the same named assertion. Cell A remains the negative precedence
control: the same caller default must not beat a persona file pin.
